description: Vicmap Transport - Road Infrastructure Point is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Transport and Planning. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
